body:
Hello! 👋

@vvo @bobylito @LukyVj 

I used this icon because it's something I'm used to seeing around to web for both 'copy to clipboard' and 'duplicate' 

I usually go to thenounproject to make sure is not something subjective: 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26247132/27534162-5792ca38-5a66-11e7-9713-4e1b0c8163f4.png)

In my opinion, if there's an icon for a simple action like this one it's better to use that than text as it's easier to process quickly and it separates better from the written word which in this case is abundant. However, I can't speak for a user of documentation, if you guys think it's still better to go with text I don't think it's a 'design breaker' 🤷‍♀️
